g.text: Legend (SysML v2 action flow view): rounded box = action (name : performer type); small squares = parameters (in on the
entry side, out on the exit side); filled circle = start, bull's eye = done, diamond = decide; open arrow = succession
with [guard]; thick filled arrow = flow of an item.
